verdict.rationale: TaxJar publishes an API reference with per-endpoint docs, official clients in seven languages, and a sandbox endpoint where requests can be tried safely. No evidence shows the reference is interactive or has in-browser runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable or executable examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
